title: Audit ingest & ILM operator Terraform module for VPC private deployments
creator: Maya Torres
description: Build a reusable Terraform module that wires CloudTrail -> S3 ingest into a KMS-encrypted bucket, applies S3 lifecycle tiers, and manages OpenSearch index lifecycle (rollover, forcemerge, shrink) via an optional ILM operator. Support cross-account delivery, configurable retention by log type, a canary index workflow for safe ILM changes, and an upgrade hook that migrates policies without data loss. Target compatibility: Terraform v1.5+, AWS provider ~>5.0. Avoid local-exec where possible and provide clear upgrade playbook for Private customers.
comments: 2025-02-16 - Maya Torres: Scoped module boundaries. Decided to include an optional Lambda-based ILM operator to orchestrate safe rollovers and policy migration rather than relying solely on provider-driven ILM changes.

2025-02-20 - Ethan Liu: PoC Lambda implemented to call OpenSearch rollover and apply ILM with exponential backoff. PoC commit pushed: github.com/redwood-inference/private-ops/commit/5f2a9c. Need to parameterize role ARNs and make operator optional for air-gapped installs.

2025-02-25 - Security review notes: Default retention proposed: 90 days for CloudTrail, 365 days for forensic logs. Security requested CMEK enforcement option, KMS rotation guidance, and audit log access controls. Added security flag to module inputs.

2025-02-28 - Integration tests: Spun a CI VPC stack to validate cross-account CloudTrail delivery and lifecycle transitions. Detected S3 notification eventual consistency; added a verification step with 30s backoff in tests.

2025-03-03 - Ethan Liu: Implemented canary index pattern (<prefix>-canary-YYYY.MM.DD). Upgrade flow: apply ILM to canary, validate document ingestion and search correctness, then promote alias to new policy. Drafted upgrade playbook and smoke test list.
Next: document module inputs/outputs, add acceptance tests to repo, and add CloudWatch alarms for ILM failures.
steps: Define module inputs: name_prefix, retention_days_by_log_type (map), kms_key_arn, enable_cross_account (bool), bucket_tier_policy_days (map), opensearch_endpoint, opensearch_role_arn, enable_ilm_operator (bool)
Provision S3 bucket with server-side encryption (CMEK optional), bucket policy to allow CloudTrail cross-account delivery, and lifecycle rules by prefix
Create IAM roles and policies for ingest worker and optional ILM operator Lambda with least-privilege permissions
Deploy optional ILM operator Lambda (Docker or zip) behind VPC endpoints that calls OpenSearch REST APIs and reports metrics to CloudWatch
Provide outputs: bucket_name, bucket_arn, ilm_operator_lambda_arn (if enabled), opensearch_policy_version, canary_index_pattern
Add integration tests that exercise cross-account delivery, lifecycle transition verification, and an ILM rollover cycle using the canary workflow
Document upgrade playbook: steps to migrate ILM policies, run canaries, validate document counts and search, and rollback instructions
acceptance_criteria: Module deploys into a private VPC and accepts CloudTrail delivery from a different AWS account into a KMS-encrypted S3 bucket
S3 lifecycle transitions are created per configured prefixes and verified by CI integration tests
Optional ILM operator can apply ILM policies, trigger rollover, and emit success/failure metrics to CloudWatch
Canary workflow exists and upgrade playbook documents steps to validate policy changes before promoting to production aliases
Integration tests run in CI for cross-account delivery, lifecycle behavior, and index rollover at least once per PR
Security checklist completed: CMEK optional but enforceable; least-privilege IAM templates provided
